names.note: Read out of the title on his name link behind his line for 29 октября ст. ст., «Евгений (Ивашко), протоиерей, сщмч.», with the rank word and the grade left off; his life page is headed «Священномученик Евгений (Ивашко)», which gives the same form. The line on the day page gives only the forename, in the genitive, and no surname: «Сщмч. Евгения пресвитера (1937).»

birth.note: The Сретенский calendar's life: «Священномученик Евгений родился 26 августа 1899 года в семье священника Минской епархии Александра Ивашко».

death.note: The line prints «(1937)» and the life gives the day: «Священник Евгений Ивашко был расстрелян 11 ноября 1937 года» — the civil date of this menologion day, shot two days after a troika of the NKVD ordered it on 9 November.

feast.note: His name page and his life page both list one other day, «26 января (Новомуч.)», the synaxis of the new martyrs and confessors of Russia. One row per church is the schema, so the second day is recorded here and he does not render on it.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 29 октября ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Евгения пресвитера (1937).»
source.note: The line stands in the day's third paragraph, which carries no typikon icon, so no rank is recorded.

attestations.note: The line's «Сщмч.» is hieromartyr and goes in `types`; the link's «протоиерей» is the grade and goes in `office`, and both are said in the life. **The line calls him a presbyter and the link an archpriest**, which is the usual disagreement on this calendar and is handled the standing way. The surname «Ивашко» returns no other folder. The life names four bishops who moved him from parish to parish and the bishop whose letter against the renovationists he was given to copy; none has a folder here and none is made. He was glorified for general church veneration by the Jubilee Council of Bishops of August 2000, which the life's closing line states.
